run_aria_live_streamer: run the aria live streamer CLI to detect AprilTags and objects from Aria glasses
create_AriaLiveReader: create an AriaLiveReader instance to livestream frames and publish pose data on ROS topics
connect_aria_device: connect the AriaLiveReader to the Aria device streaming client to start receiving frames
process_frame_with_detectors: process a frame dict with AprilTag and object detection using the AriaLiveReader
get_latest_pose_and_image: get the latest frame dict containing rectified image and pose from the AriaLiveReader
